free_tier.stated: Free accounts are view-only as of March 2026: 'all new user accounts are view only ... you cannot use the API or download NZBs, just view the releases'. caps declares <registration available="no" open="no"/> and <limits max="500" default="250"/>.
free_tier.notes: Older reviews still say '10 downloads and 100 API queries daily' for free; that reading is contradicted by the March 2026 admin statement and is not used.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file

retention.stated: not published on any page reachable today; a third-party listing claims 'up to 100 days for binary files, 50+ indexed groups'.

egress.terms: No byte metering; the API returns pointers.

interface_detail: Newznab API at /api, 500 results per request (the highest cap). The HTML site answers a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' interstitial on every path tried.
tooling: Native Newznab and the reference testbed for the NNTmux software other indexers run, so its API shape matches what Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 expect. The account is the obstacle, not a user.
chaining: Nothing on the free side; it becomes a broad index only on a paid supporter tier, which a user cannot obtain while registration is shut.

limits.value: 0 API hits and 0 NZB downloads on a free account (view only)
registration unavailable; new accounts are created view-only when the door opens

binding_note: Registration fails first: available=no in the vendor's own caps, so a client cannot reach a quota to be limited by.

identity_cost.detail: Closed. caps declares registration available=no; a third-party status tracker records 'Registration closed / site offline' as of 2026-10-06.

reliability_note: New free accounts receive no API key and no download right even when registration opens, so an account created on a good day still cannot be used by an arr stack.
confidence_note: caps and the registration state were measured today; the view-only free tier is a dated third-party quote of an admin statement and is labelled as such.

evidence.proved: caps returned 200 and 125,232 bytes: title Tabula Rasa, <limits max="500" default="250"/>, <registration available="no" open="no"/>
the HTML site answered a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' interstitial (5,821 bytes, 403), so no page text was readable directly
third-party, dated Mar 2026: 'all new user accounts are view only ... you cannot use the API or download NZBs'
third-party status, checked 2026-10-06: 'Registration closed / site offline'
